result.reason: The revision appropriately extends the licence to Affiliates and contractors and limits revocation to an uncured material breach. However, it does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable, distinguish subscription licences from paid-up licences, or permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction. The successor-transfer requirement is absent under both the preferred and fallback positions. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the use restrictions and service-related scope.
